component.name: Huenicorn
component.summary: Drive Philips Hue lights from what is on your screen

description.p: Huenicorn captures your screen and streams matching colors to Philips Hue entertainment zones, giving an ambient lighting effect around whatever you are watching or playing. It is configured through a web interface served by the application itself.
Screen capture uses the desktop portal on Wayland and X11 directly elsewhere, so no additional capture setup is needed.
